Author: Prem Narayan Singh
Bench: Prem Narayan Singh
 1
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
 Crr No. 3306 of 2023
 (Vikas Gulati Vs The State Of Madhya Prad
 Dated : 27-07-2023

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Manoj Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Rajesh Joshi, learned Government   respondent/State.

Heard on I.A. No. 11287/2023, which is an application filed under Section 397 read with Section 401 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of applicant.

2. The applicant has been convicted under Section 16(1)(a)(i) and (ii) read with Section 7(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo 1 years R.I. with fine of Rs.10,000/- in each sentence and usual default stipulations.

5 . Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the Courts below have not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record and committed error in convicting the applicant.
This revision would take considerable to dispose of finally.

Under these circumstances,
looking to the short sentence, learned counsel prays that the application for suspension of sentence of the petitioner be allowed.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of the application for suspension of sentence.

7 . Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, contention of learned counsel for the petitioner, the short sentence of the petitioner, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed and it is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if already not deposited, the petitioner shall be released on bail, on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court firstly on 18.10.2023 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard, till final disposal of this revision.

Certified copy as per rules.
